title: J061--PROJECT 675-25-804, Bid-Build (BB) Install Water Tower  Projector System at Lake Nona

detail_text: Presolicitation Notice Presolicitation Notice Page 4 of 4 Presolicitation Notice Presolicitation Notice Page 1 of 4 DESCRIPTION PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE: THIS NOTICE IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS. VENDOR SHOULD NOT SUBMIT FORMAL PROPOSALS UNTIL THE REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP) IS POSTED TO THIS WEBSITE. PROJEC NO./TITLE: Bid-Build (BB) Install Water Tower Projector System at Lake Nona, Project 675-25-804 Work Location: Orlando VA Healthcare System Lake Nona VA Facility 13800 Veterans Way Orlando, FL 32827 Proposed Solicitation Number: 36C24826R0107 Point of Contact: Elizabeth Romero, Contracting Officer, email: elizabeth.romero@va.gov, Network Contracting Office (NCO) 8, Construction Team 3. This requirement is set-aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Businesses (SDVOSB). General Description: The Department of Veteran Affairs (VA), Veterans Integrated Service Network (VISN) 8, Orlando Veterans Affairs Healthcare System (OVAHCS) has a requirement for construction services to address the requirement for a projections system on the water tower. All work shall be executed in compliance with the terms and conditions outlined in Solicitation 36C24826R0107 and all applicable OSHA, federal, state, and local regulations. The requirement focuses on the installation of a projector system and enclosure. The contractor shall complete the work required within 180 calendar days from receipt of Notice to Proceed (NTP) in accordance with the construction drawings and specifications. The solicitation is anticipated to be issued on or about 05/22/2026. All information for this solicitation will be posted on the SAM.gov website at www.sam.gov. All interested firms must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM.GOV). Important Notice: Prior to submitting a proposal under SDVOSB set-aside solicitation, offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM.GOV) and certified in the SBA Veteran Certification site https://search.certifications.sba.gov/ as an active SBA SDVOSB certified. A joint venture may be considered an SDVOSB concern eligible under the SDVOSB Program if (1). The joint venture qualifies as small under 19.201-1(b)(1), (2). The managing SDVOSB joint venture partner is designated in SAM as an SDVOSB concern certified by SBA; and (3) The joint venture complies with the requirements of 13 CFR 128.402.
